skillList.title: Skill list
skillList.summary: A group of skills of one kind, paid from one ability
skillList.description: A list of skills, spells or powers for one world. The skills in it are paid from the list's own ability, such as Mana, instead of XP.

setting.title: World
setting.description: The world this list belongs to. Empty means shared across all worlds.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name players see, such as Arcane spells.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Whether the list holds skills, spells or powers.

costAbility.title: Paid from
costAbility.description: The ability the costs of these skills are paid from, such as Mana. Empty means XP.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the list is for, shown in the rulebook.

order.title: Order
order.description: Where the list comes in the rulebook; lower comes first.

hiddenFromRulebook.title: Hidden from the rulebook
hiddenFromRulebook.description: Leave this out of the players' rulebook, for example a secret ability.

list.title: List
list.description: The list this skill belongs to. A skill without a list is a general skill paid from XP.

hiddenFromRulebook.title: Hidden from the rulebook
hiddenFromRulebook.description: Leave this out of the players' rulebook, for example a secret ability.
